const tasks = [
  { key: 'B1a', label: 'blind-op-review:call-graph', schema: OPS_SCHEMA, prompt: `${COMMON}${BLIND}

${SEAM_CONTRACT}

  { key: 'B7', label: 'deps-loadset-commands', schema: GENERIC_SCHEMA, prompt: `${COMMON}

(1) Every .csproj under src/ and tests/: target framework, ProjectReference, PackageReference (with versions), Reference/HintPath (AutoCAD assemblies AcCoreMgd/AcDbMgd/AcMgd and their paths), Directory.Build.props/targets effects (e.g. InformationalVersion stamping), satellite/resource assemblies (.resx, culture folders), embedded resources. (3) How the plugin is loaded (NETLOAD, autoloader PackageContents.xml, IExtensionApplication/PluginInitializer and what Initialize does), static constructors or module initializers with side effects. (4) Command registration: every [CommandMethod] in src (name, class, flags if any, whether the class is static or instance), whether any command runs in application context (CommandFlags.Session), any SendStringToExecute/SendCommand/Application.Invoke usage, any LISP-callable functions (LispFunction). (5) How CI builds (the .github workflow): which projects are built/tested, whether the Plugin is excluded and why. Output facts and tables.` },
]

REVIEW A: ${opA}
REVIEW B: ${opB}
TASK: (1) build the union of reached operations (dedupe by call site), (2) for EVERY call site that appears in only one review, or that the two classify differently (reached vs not, seam role, transaction context), open the code and ADJUDICATE with file:line evidence, (3) search the code once more for any database-mutating call site on those paths that NEITHER review found, (4) adjudicate the contract_required_operations lists (union, remove non-requirements). Return a table of the final union (operation id, category, api_call, location, seam role, transaction context, found_by A/B/BOTH/CRITIC), a table of adjudications (site, A says, B says, verdict, evidence), and a list of residual facts that no method can see statically.`, { label: 'critic:op-reviews', phase: 'Verify', schema: GENERIC_SCHEMA })

const censusAll = JSON.stringify(['B2a', 'B2b', 'B2c', 'B2d'].map(k => ({ key: k, entries: (results[k] || {}).entries || [], scope: (results[k] || {}).scope })))
const verifyCensus = agent(`${COMMON}

You are the COMPLETENESS CRITIC of a mutable static-state census over src/RackCad.Domain, src/RackCad.Application and src/RackCad.Plugin. The census entries reported so far follow as JSON: ${censusAll}
TASK: run an independent exhaustive sweep (grep for the patterns: "static " fields that are not const, "static readonly" with mutable types including arrays and collections, static properties with set, ThreadStatic, ThreadLocal, Lazy<, static event, "static .*Instance", static constructors, ModuleInitializer) across those three projects, and list every static mutable member that is MISSING from the census (with file:line and kind), plus every census entry you believe is WRONG (not mutable, or wrong reachability) with evidence. Also give the total count of static mutable members you found per project. Return facts and tables.`, { label: 'critic:census', phase: 'Verify', schema: GENERIC_SCHEMA })

const [vo, vc] = await parallel([() => verifyOps, () => verifyCensus])
results.critic_ops = vo
results.critic_census = vc
return results
